units.title: Compute the actual signed Gaussian test expectation
units.statement: Let n>=3, kappa>=4 and ell>=0, including zero. For every full real orthogonal O put A_O=((kappa+1)/2)I-((kappa-1)/4)(O+O transpose), gamma_O the actual canonical Gaussian N(0,A_O inverse), p_O(x)=sqrt(det A_O)/(2pi)^(n/2) exp(-x^T A_O x/2) on actual Euclidean volume, and t(x)=exp(-ell||x||_2^2). For every O, t is absolutely L1 under gamma_O, t*p_O is absolutely L1 under Euclidean volume, and their integrals agree. The signed expectation O -> det(O) integral t d gamma_O is absolutely L1 under the actual normalized full O(n) Haar probability. Its Haar average equals (-1)^(n-1)(sqrt(kappa)-1)^(n-1)/2^(n/2) times the Haar average of ((sqrt(kappa)+1)U-(sqrt(kappa)-1))/(kappa+1+4ell-(kappa-1)U)^(n/2), where U=O_11. All dimension-half powers use real division. None of the L1, density or transport conclusions is a caller hypothesis. This identifies the actual signed Gaussian test expectation, without constructing determinant-conditioned target mixtures or proving their relation to TV.
assumptions: Exactly n>=3, kappa>=4 and ell>=0 including ell=0.

Existing literal precision, actual canonical Gaussian covariance A_O inverse, canonical Euclidean volume and actual full orthogonal Haar probability, with both determinant signs. The norm is the true Euclidean norm and WithLp.ofLp supplies coordinates.

Gaussian test L1, weighted-volume L1, density nonnegativity/measurability, law-to-density integral equality and signed outer Haar L1 are proved internally. No caller probability-density or integrability premise.

steps.title: Bound the actual Gaussian test
steps.text: The test is continuous and satisfies 0<t(x)<=1 because ell>=0 and the squared true Euclidean norm is nonnegative. Each actual canonical Gaussian is a probability measure, so domination by the constant one gives genuine absolute Gaussian L1, including the endpoint ell=0.
steps.lean: The proof uses actual multivariateGaussian probability, continuity and an explicit norm bound; Gaussian test integrability is produced internally.

steps.title: Use the identical exact Gaussian law-density node
steps.text: The literal p_O is nonnegative and measurable: its factors are nonnegative square root, positive-base real-power denominator and positive exponential of a continuous quadratic. The existing exact source density theorem identifies gamma_O with Euclidean volume.withDensity(ofReal p_O), under unchanged bounds and every full O.
steps.lean: The proof actually calls GaussianLawDensity.gaussian_law_eq_density hn hκ O. Positivity and measurability are verified for the unchanged explicit p_O; no substitute Gaussian constructor is introduced.

steps.title: Transport both integrability and the expectation
steps.text: Apply the existing Mathlib withDensity integrability equivalence to the now proved Gaussian test L1. Since p_O is finite and nonnegative, ofReal(p_O).toReal equals p_O, yielding weighted-volume L1. The existing withDensity Bochner integral theorem then gives the exact pointwise expectation equality. Both sides have proved absolute integrability.
steps.lean: The proof uses integrable_withDensity_iff and integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul, with internal measurable/finite/nonnegative density proofs. ENNReal.ofReal and multiplication order are simplified exactly.

steps.title: Produce genuine signed outer Haar L1
steps.text: The already compiled literal Fubini theorem supplies absolute joint L1 of det(O)t(x)p_O(x) under the same Haar probability times Euclidean volume. Its integrated sections are Haar L1. Pull det(O) outside each spatial integral and replace that integral by the pointwise actual Gaussian expectation proved above. Thus the actual signed expectation is measurable and absolutely Haar L1 without requiring a new Gaussian-kernel or mixture constructor.
steps.lean: The proof consumes the exact literal_mixture_transform joint-L1 conclusion and actual Integrable.integral_prod_left, then pointwise congruence and integral_const_mul. No unproved family-measurability premise is supplied.

steps.title: Compose the actual expectation with the evaluated literal transform
steps.text: Integrate the pointwise law-to-density equality against the same determinant-weighted Haar law. This gives precisely the literal H already evaluated by the canonical Fubini, norm-axis, radial Gaussian and B6 chain. Apply that identical parent theorem to obtain the displayed Eq21 coefficient and expectation. This step identifies H_gamma with literal H; interpreting H using determinant-conditioned target laws and TV remains a later step.
steps.lean: The final composition uses the same pointwise expectation transport and exact equality projection of MixtureFubini.literal_mixture_transform hn hκ hℓ. No Gaussian/B6/Fubini proof is copied, and no TV or Poisson conclusion is asserted.

units.lean_statement: Unchanged preproof exact signature, literal p/t/U/a and actual gamma/Haar, pointwise and outer L1, exact Eq21.
units.lean_proof: Internal bounded-test L1 and actual withDensity transport compose the exact law-density and literal Fubini parents.
units.boundary: Actual pointwise Gaussian test/weighted-density L1 and transport, genuine signed outer Haar L1 and exact actual Gaussian H through Eq21. Determinant-conditioned target-mixture construction/half-mass, Ex57/Eq20 H-to-TV, sphere/Poisson, parameter choice, amplification/transcript/eigenbasis and both main lower bounds remain open. Sharp Ex59 and B6 minor/path estimates retain unchanged disclosed parent boundaries. No sign-to-eigenbasis lower-bound implication.
